clw __VERSION__ — signed binaries (minisign SHA256SUMS.minisig + minisign.pub), CycloneDX SBOM. Proprietary (EULA governs use); binaries publicly downloadable, source closed. macOS: a direct browser download is Gatekeeper-blocked (binary not yet Apple-notarized) — install via 'brew' or install.sh (both strip quarantine), or run 'xattr -d com.apple.quarantine <asset>' after verifying the signature. See docs/INSTALL.md.
